comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks an angular-gripper opening stop; PR-998 loads a housing into a rollover fixture, retains and inverts it, locks the cradle, then fits a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver seating, thin-nut wrenching and countertorque; PR-998 requires part loading, sliding-bar closure, crank rotation, lock-bolt insertion and recessed placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades target angle, nut retention, repeated actuation and drift; PR-998 grades correct housing orientation, retention before inversion, 180° fixture angle, bolt engagement, pad seating and released stillness. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve locking, but PR-998 tests safe fixture sequencing and inversion rather than coupled threaded calibration preserved against tightening reaction.
